items.title: Hashless venue guards let outsiders block new opens.
items.description: An outsider can extend a growable venue without a stored ELF hash, then block new opens until Emergency revalidation.

gates.execution: ALLOWS: legitimate ProgramData satisfies the fixed key, loader owner, and tag checks; an extension moves its slot, and absent fingerprints skip is_upgrade.
gates.reachability: ALLOWS: initialize_config enables unflagged venues with zero fingerprint lengths; exact-slot revalidate_venue also accepts a zero hash and clears the fingerprint.
gates.trigger: ALLOWS: an outsider pays the extension rent and calls permissionless flag_venue_upgraded; no venue upgrade signature is needed.
gates.impact: CONFIRMED bounded interruption: open_short and candidate adoption fail while latched until Emergency revalidation; exits, add_margin, and withdrawals do not consult this latch.

guard_trace: Accounts: FlagVenueUpgraded checks the canonical VenueGuard PDA, index, constant ProgramData key, and loader owner; it has no signer role.
Init: initialize_config:156-160 writes upgraded = 0 and guard_slot without a fingerprint.
Admin: revalidate_venue:72-83 permits a zero hash at the exact slot; :104-108 clears the fingerprint and bit. A hashed review remains an available recovery.
Deposit: no guard path creates a permanent deposit or withdrawal lock in this candidate.

Swap/open: flag_venue_upgraded:126-137 records the changed slot with no fingerprint; open_short:291 and engine::guard::latch:110-115 reject every open under the venue mask. Both Raydium kinds share the mask; candidate_latch uses the candidate program bit.
Withdraw/liquidate/close: these exit paths do not read VenueGuard; the claim is bounded to new opens and affected listing/adoption paths.
gate_evidence.runtime_support: Installed solana-bpf-loader-program 4.2.2 dispatches ExtendProgram with check_authority=false; common_extend_program requires a writable matching upgradeable ProgramData, capacity, a later slot, and rent funding, then grows data and writes clock_slot. Use 10 KiB, or the remaining capacity if smaller, to satisfy the optional minimum-size feature.
gate_evidence.confidence_basis: 100 - 15 bounded/recoverable interruption - 10 specific achievable hashless, still-growable venue state = 75. Initialization already creates this state, so no separate honest-admin-call deduction applies.
gate_evidence.proof_limit: Static source proof only. No deployment query established present lengths or fingerprint state. The claim applies to source-identified growable venues with headroom and a hashless guard; pump and PumpSwap at the 10 MiB cap are excluded. It does not claim locked existing funds or an unavailable Emergency recovery.

items.known_issue_comparison: Exact match to accepted KI-69(a): the runbook calls for hashed revalidations after init, and the owner accepted the residual. This acceptance is reported, but the client/runbook is not an on-chain guard. The unprivileged extension is the amplifier; this is distinct from AIR2-07 collision hardening.

dedup_notes: 16 raw candidates produce 14 items: 1 finding and 13 leads; 0 raw candidates rejected. Every raw ID has one disposition.
Merged p1-a06-b02 and p1-a09-b02: both quote the same Raydium parse checks in both loaders and request the same authority checks; both are hardening leads.
Merged p1-a06-b04 and p1-a11-b06: both quote elf_fingerprint_of and the same 12-byte comparison. The hardening label is retained so no hardening item becomes a normal finding.

Do not merge p1-a01-b01 with p1-a10-b01: adapter pricing_inputs and library pump_curve are different primary functions in different canonical programs; related helper citations alone do not license renaming or cross-function lead folding.
Keep pricing_inputs synthetic-risk supply and synthetic-fee gate mismatch separate: a supply snapshot does not align fee gates, while route-aware gates do not fix mutable risk supply.
Keep ordinary curve spot-risk fees separate from the synthetic live-supply risk fee: the former needs the ordinary EMA risk view; the latter needs supply handling.
Only p1-a11-b05 supplies raw diff ADD lines among these candidates. Its sole diff is preserved verbatim; there are no distinct alternative raw diffs to omit or synthesize.
Initial ledger is empty. Existing issue rows and prejudgment context are comparison context only, and no referenced test was treated as reproduced proof.

No build, test, runtime reproduction, deployment query, or source edit ran. Guards were judged once in Accounts -> init -> admin -> deposit -> swap -> withdraw -> liquidate -> close order; later gates are marked not evaluated after a failure.
